open_points.subject: M18 FlowActivation / K-08 activation of read-only flows
open_points.text: K-08: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven"; Primary actions: "activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once"
open_points.question: When exactly is a proven read-only flow activated: automatically at successful proof, only when an activate action is called, or both?
options: Automatic on successful proof/composition (no explicit activate call needed)
Only via explicit activate action; kernel just performs it immediately for read-only
Automatic on proof and also callable explicitly (which may create another activation)

open_points.subject: M18 FlowActivation record creation on repeated activation of the same flow version
open_points.text: M18: "A flow's active version is the one recorded last ... a new activation replaces the previous one at once" (no rule for targeting the version that is already active)
open_points.question: If activation is requested (or auto-triggered) for a flow version that is already active, does the kernel append a new FlowActivation record or return the existing active one without writing?
options: Append a new FlowActivation record each time activation succeeds
Idempotent: return current active activation and write nothing
open_points.default_guess: Append a new activation record for auditability.

open_points.subject: M22 SpooledFile read action at product surface
open_points.text: State 0 primary actions list only "read a trace" for trace reading, while M22 says spooled bytes are read "by the owner's inspection read of its bytes ... the State 5 operation `read_spooled_file`"
open_points.question: Is reading spooled file bytes a State-0/State-1 product action, and if yes, who is allowed to do it?
options: Yes, explicit owner-only action exists to read spooled bytes
Yes, both owner and agent may read spooled bytes (with K-14 masking for agent)
No separate byte-read action; only metadata appears in trace inspection
